answer.summary: A narrow, testable research question is required to investigate observable memory persistence in tokenized agents under periodic input with known perturbations, grounded solely in explicitly reported metrics from the source literature.
answer.content: Formulate a new research question that examines the minimum duration of periodic input required to maintain observable memory persistence in a tokenized agent, using only explicitly reported retention or state stability metrics from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, and avoiding any unverified or inferred data points. This question must be bounded by verifiable, time-based retention values to ensure testability and alignment with available evidence.
